Messages.Author: Rory Geoghegan
Messages.Body:
If a vampire changes sects (Out of the Frying Pan, Into the Fire,
etc...), does your clan change? For example, does a brujah anti-tribu
who plays 'Out of the Frying Pan' become a brujah?

I would say no but my local Prince stated that a vampire's clan does
change along with the sect.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


Out of the Frying Pan: "Trifle. Choose a ready Sabbat vampire you
control. That vampire becomes Camarilla. (his or her clan is not affected.)"

Into the Fire: "Trifle. Choose a ready non-Sabbat vampire you control.
That vampire becomes Sabbat. (His or her clan is not affected)"

Seems pretty obvious to me.

--Colin McGuigan
